questions.question_english: The concept of the “Creamy Layer” applies to the exclusion of advanced sections from reservation benefits. To which of the following categories does the “Creamy Layer” exclusion principle currently apply in direct recruitment under Article 16(4)?
options_english: Option A
Option B
Other Backward Classes (OBCs)
Option D
questions.explanation_english: The concept of the Creamy Layer was introduced to exclude socially and economically advanced individuals within a backward class from reservation benefits. In direct recruitment under public employment, this exclusion principle applies strictly to Other Backward Classes (OBCs), as affirmed by the Supreme Court, while not applying to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। क्रीम लेयर का सिद्धांत सामाजिक और आर्थिक रूप से उन्नत व्यक्तियों को आरक्षण लाभ से बाहर करने के लिए पेश किया गया था। सार्वजनिक रोजगार में सीधी भर्ती के तहत, यह अपवाद सिद्धांत विशेष रूप से अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (ओबीसी) पर लागू होता है, जैसा कि सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वारा पुष्टि की गई है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: The Creamy Layer principle excludes advanced individuals from reservation benefits.
It applies specifically to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) in direct recruitment.
Printed answer key: (c) Other Backward Classes (OBCs)

questions.question_english: The Principal of a Government Boys Senior Secondary School is designated as the Head of Office. A teacher submits a bill for the purchase of classroom teaching aids. Before forwarding the bill to the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO), what is the most appropriate action the Principal must take as per GFR definitions and responsibilities?
options_english: Verify sanction by competent authority and receipt of items in good condition.
Forward the bill immediately to Pay and Accounts Office without verifying the stock register entries.
Direct the concerned teacher to pay from personal funds and apply for annual reimbursement later.
Send the bill directly to the Department of Expenditure in the Ministry of Finance.
questions.explanation_english: The correct action is to verify the sanction by a competent authority and ensure that the items have been received in good condition. This is in accordance with the General Financial Rules (GFR), which mandate that all expenditures must be properly authorized and that the receipt of goods should be confirmed before processing payments. This ensures accountability and proper financial management within educational institutions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रधान को सक्षम प्राधिकरण द्वारा स्वीकृति की पुष्टि करनी चाहिए और यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि सामान अच्छी स्थिति में प्राप्त हुआ है। यह सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों (GFR) के अनुसार है, जो यह अनिवार्य करते हैं कि सभी व्यय को सही तरीके से अधिकृत किया जाना चाहिए और भुगतान की प्रक्रिया से पहले सामान की प्राप्ति की पुष्टि की जानी चाहिए। यह शैक्षणिक संस्थानों के भीतर जवाबदेही और उचित वित्तीय प्रबंधन सुनिश्चित करता है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD EWS SC ST and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: General Financial Rules (GFR) emphasize the need for verification of sanctions and receipt of goods.
Proper authorization is crucial for financial management in educational institutions.
Printed answer key: (A) Verify sanction by competent authority and receipt of items in good condition.
